faqs.question: Down payment kitna hota hai?
faqs.answer: Ye property se property vary karta hai, generally 20% se 50% tak. Poori detail property ki payment plan mein mil jayegi.

faqs.question: Kya installment plan available hai har property par?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar under-construction aur naye launch properties par installment plans available hain. Ready-to-move properties par aksar full payment required hoti hai.

faqs.question: Kya property clear title hai?
faqs.answer: Sab humari listings verified aur clear title ke saath hoti hain, documentation site visit ke waqt dikhayi jati hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap registry aur transfer mein madad karte hain?
faqs.answer: Ji haan, humari legal team registry aur transfer ke pure process mein madad karti hai, advisory ke liye koi extra charge nahi hai.

faqs.question: Site visit ke liye kya charges hain?
faqs.answer: Site visit bilkul free hai, hum khud aap ko property tak le jate hain.

faqs.question: Visit kis din book kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Visits Monday se Sunday tak book ho sakti hain, subah 10 baje se shaam 7 baje tak, aap ka jo waqt suit kare.

faqs.question: Rent pe security deposit kitna hota hai?
faqs.answer: Generally 2 mahine ka rent bataur security deposit liya jata hai, property ke hisaab se thoda vary kar sakta hai.

faqs.question: Kya rent pe furnished options bhi available hain?
faqs.answer: Ji haan, kuch listings furnished aur semi-furnished bhi hain, ye property description mein clearly mention hota hai.

faqs.question: Investment ke liye best area kaun sa hai?
faqs.answer: Ye aap ke budget aur risk appetite par depend karta hai. Bahria Town aur DHA extensions generally strong appreciation history rakhte hain, lekin main koi guarantee nahi de sakta, ye historical trend hai.

faqs.question: Kya rental yield ki guarantee hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi, rental yield guarantee nahi ki ja sakti, main sirf historical data share kar sakta hoon jo humare paas available hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap sirf Karachi mein properties dikhate hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi, humari listings Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad aur Rawalpindi mein available hain.

faqs.question: Kya property dekhne se pehle booking amount deni hoti hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi, site visit ke liye koi booking amount nahi chahiye, booking sirf tab hoti hai jab aap decide kar lein.

faqs.question: Late installment par kya penalty hai?
faqs.answer: Late payment par developer ke policy ke hisaab se penalty lag sakti hai, exact rate property ki payment plan document mein mention hota hai.

faqs.question: Agar property mein dispute ho to kya hoga?
faqs.answer: Humari saari listed properties dispute-free verify ki jati hain listing se pehle, lekin agar koi concern ho to hamari legal team turant guide karti hai.

faqs.question: Commercial property lene ke liye extra documentation chahiye?
faqs.answer: Ji haan, commercial properties ke liye business registration aur NTN number generally required hota hai, poori list hum aap ko share kar dete hain.

faqs.question: Kya aap resale properties bhi list karte hain?
faqs.answer: Ji bilkul, naye launch ke ilawa hum verified resale properties bhi list karte hain.

faqs.question: Kya visit ke doran family bhi aa sakti hai?
faqs.answer: Bilkul, hum encourage karte hain ke family ke saath visit karein taake sab ki opinion shamil ho.

faqs.question: Kya bank loan/mortgage arrange karne mein madad milti hai?
faqs.answer: Ji haan, hum kuch partner banks ke through mortgage guidance provide karte hain, final approval bank ki policy par depend karta hai.

faqs.question: Rent agreement kitne arse ka hota hai?
faqs.answer: Zyadatar rent agreements 11 mahine ke hote hain, renewal mutual agreement se ho sakta hai.

faqs.question: Agar mujhe property pasand na aaye to kya hoga?
faqs.answer: Koi masla nahi, hum aap ko aap ki requirements ke mutabiq aur options dikhate rahenge jab tak aap ko sahi property na mil jaye.

property_description_chunks.text: Modern 3-Bed Bungalow in DHA Phase 6, Karachi. Freshly built with contemporary finishes, located close to Khayaban-e-Sehar. Corner plot design allows extra sunlight and cross-ventilation throughout the home. Ideal for a small to mid-size family looking for a ready-to-move residential option.

Luxury 4-Bed Villa in Bahria Town Phase 8, Rawalpindi. Located within a gated community with dedicated servant quarters and a private lawn. Full amenities access including swimming pool, gym, and community park within walking distance.

Emaar Crescent Bay 3-Bed Apartment, Clifton Block 5, Karachi. Sea-facing high-rise unit with a strong rental yield history in the building. Premium amenities include elevator access, rooftop terrace, gym, and swimming pool. Popular with investors seeking rental income.

10-Marla House in DHA Phase 6, Karachi. Double-storey house with a finished basement, home theater room, and rooftop terrace. Backup generator and covered parking included. Suited for a large family wanting extra entertainment space.

1-Kanal Villa in Bahria Town Phase 8, Rawalpindi. Fully furnished with a private swimming pool and home automation system controlling lighting and security. Ready to move, full payment required, no installment plan offered on this unit.

Investor Plot in Bahria Town Precinct 10, Karachi. Entry-level investment option in a rapidly appreciating sector. No immediate construction required, suitable for buy-and-hold investment strategy. Low down payment plan available at 20%.

Penthouse unit at Emaar Crescent Bay, Clifton Block 5, Karachi. Top-floor unit with panoramic sea views and private elevator access. Premium finishes throughout, includes access to building's rooftop terrace, gym, and swimming pool. Highest-value residential listing in the current inventory.

Commercial Office space in Gulberg III, Lahore, available for rent. Fully fitted and move-in ready, suitable for a corporate branch, agency, or consultancy. Includes 4 dedicated parking bays and 24/7 security access.

Rental Shop in Bahria Town Phase 8 commercial strip, Rawalpindi. Prime location on the main commercial boulevard with high daily foot traffic. Currently vacant and available for immediate occupancy, suitable for retail or a small clinic.

Farmhouse-suited Plot in Bahria Town Precinct 10, Karachi. Larger plot size in a semi-developed sector, appropriate for a farmhouse-style build with garden space. Lower down payment plan available for early sector investors.
